title: Anomaly.Items.List
description: Snapshot (module Anomaly.Items): what the character carries and wears, and its coins, each item with whether this character can use it now. Sent on any change, including a change in usability alone (training past an item's level, an alignment change), on subscription and on request. Gang items in the gang pouch are left out, as `i` leaves them out (the pouch rule). Items on the ground (Items.Ground) are not part of 1.1.0.

iid.description: the engine's item InstanceId: this copy of the item, unique within a boot

canUse.description: the receiving character, now, by the engine's own check; live, never cached past the next snapshot

cannotUseBecause.description: why the engine's own use check (ItemUsability.CanUse) refuses it, in the order it checks: level (below the minimum or above the maximum), class (the class list), race (the race list), weaponType (the class's weapon type), armourType (armour heavier than the class allows), magical (a Magical item and an anti-magic class), alignment (Good/Evil/Neutral-only, the evil-point minimum, Not-Good, Not-Evil). The engine stops at the first refusal, so this holds one reason; empty when canUse is true

items.description: One entry per copy carried. uses: charges left where the item has them, else null.
